description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayChannel configuration and WebSocket request handling within the OpenClaw plugin framework for macOS. It defines test cases that verify WebSocket connection reuse, reconfiguration on token change, concurrent request handling, and subscription snapshot replay.

classes.name: ConfigSource
classes.description: A thread-safe class that holds a token used for WebSocket connection configuration. Provides methods to retrieve and set the token.

methods.name: makeConnection
methods.description: Creates a GatewayConnection instance with a specified WebSocket session and optional token.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session with hooks to simulate send and receive behaviors.
